en: The Question on the Characteristic of Energy (Vīriya)
"Venerable Nāgasena, what is the characteristic of energy?
"Supporting is the characteristic of energy, Great King; all wholesome states, when supported by energy, do not decline."
“Just as, great king, if a man were to prop up a house that was falling down with another beam, that house, being propped up, would not fall;
even so, great king, energy has the characteristic of propping up. All wholesome states, when propped up by energy, do not decline.”
“Just as if, Great King, a small army were to be broken by a great army;
then the king would have them rally one another and dispatch reinforcements, giving strength to his small army step by step, together with which that small army—”
Just as a small army might break a great army, even so, Great King, energy has the characteristic of providing support; when all wholesome states are supported by energy, they do not decline.
This, Great King, was also spoken by the Blessed One:
“Bhikkhus, an energetic noble disciple abandons the unwholesome and develops the wholesome;
he abandons what is blameworthy and develops what is blameless;
Thus ends the twelfth question, on the characteristic of energy.
